newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev edges up at close on c.bank support.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev edges up at close on c.bank support.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev edged up to 216-217 per dollar at the close from 217-218 in the morning due to support from the central bank and amid low foreign currency demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"The central bank offered dollars between 218-219 levs throughout the day, deterring a possible lev's fall," one dealer said.

Commercial banks also actively offered foreign currency with most of their dollar asks below the central bank's ones, which further supported the lev amid the relatively low dollar demand, the dealer said.

Movements in the lev/dollar exchange rate next week were likely to be almost entirely dependent on the central bank, which helped the lev to recover to today's closing levels from 223 on Monday through its active dollar sales. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
